source_citation: Dilution refrigerator stage figures from Bluefors XLD400 published datasheet (cited in 04/06 reference JSONs); OFHC copper RRR and gold plating from published cryogenic engineering references (NIST cryogenic material properties); transmon die structure (CPW resonators, Josephson junctions, sapphire/niobium) from published transmon architecture literature (Koch et al. 2007 transmon; Blais et al. 2021 cQED review); SOI MZI photonic chip from 04_quantum_hardware_modalities.json silicon_photonic_soi; UHV chamber and 87Rb tweezer array from 04_quantum_hardware_modalities.json neutral_atom_rubidium87 (Ebadi et al., Nature 612, 2023).

components.name: coaxial microwave lines
components.routing: canister → 4 K → 100 mK → 15 mK, attenuator barrels at each stage

components.name: support rods
components.material: stainless steel, G10 spacers implied at stage boundaries

coplanar_waveguides.note: λ/4 CPW resonators coupling pads to readout line

josephson_junctions.note: Al/AlOx/Al junctions represented by markers at pad intersections

transmon_die.superconducting_transition_note: Al Tc ≈ 1.2 K — quench visualization collapses coherence above this (06 JSON)

edge_grating_couplers.note: grating in/out couplers at die edges

chamber.type: stainless-steel UHV chamber with glass viewports

rydberg_blockade_halos.note: ring halos around atoms inside each other's blockade radius; V = C6/r6 with C6 = 500 GHz·µm6 (04 JSON)

bloch_instrumentation.docked_panel: bottom instrument dock Bloch tab — three mini spheres (q0..q2) fed by Lindblad readouts
bloch_instrumentation.hud_overlay_toggle: optional in-scene spheres via Quantum inspector (default OFF)

parametric_bindings.generator_contract: Bay1Quantum renders the cryostat/die/MZI/tweezer rig from these dimensions; stage temps drive plate emissive via the cryo ODE; every dimension traces to 03/04/06 JSON or this file
